items.q: How is the WAMOCON Backup Planner installed?
items.a: The Backup Planner runs as a Node.js application on your own server (e.g. Mac Studio, Linux server). Installation typically takes under an hour — detailed steps are described in the documentation.
All rclone-compatible targets: Synology NAS, Google Drive, OneDrive, S3, local drives and over 70 other cloud storage providers. rclone is the underlying backup engine.

items.q: Does my data leave the server?
items.a: No. The WAMOCON Backup Planner runs entirely on your server. There is no external cloud connection, no telemetry and no external dependencies. Your data stays where you want it.
Yes. A live demo is available to explore the interface without installation. Contact us for demo access.

items.q: How much does the WAMOCON Backup Planner cost?
items.a: There is no subscription and no monthly fees. The product is self-hosted and licensed once. All details can be found in the documentation.

items.q: What tech stack is behind it?
items.a: Frontend: React + TypeScript + TailwindCSS. Backend: Node.js + Express + SQLite. Backup engine: rclone. Process manager: PM2. All proven, all open source.
